The Name

Two ideas, five letters.

STRIX isn't a random word — it's the product, written in shorthand. The name carries both what we build and the engineering that holds it together.

STR
Structure. The foundation of everything we analyze — beams, columns, walls, slabs, the whole system.
X
The cross-brace. The X-brace that resists lateral force and keeps a structure standing. Our mark is that brace, with a node at every joint.
